title: Influence bounded by maximum influence
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f:\\{-1,1\\}^n\\to\\{\\pm1\\}$, and let $i$ be a coordinate. The influence of coordinate $i$ is at most the maximum influence of $f$ over all coordinates.
